name: predjama-castle
documented_evidence: Operator describes the castle within a123m natural cliff; this is not architectural height. OSM way426772755 is explicitly named Predjama Castle and attributes its geometry to Slovenia GURS. Its mapped exterior is a32.5×25.2m L.
modeling_qualifications: National ARSO1m F32 DMR point at mapped main entrance is511.462m, so architectural datum511.5m replaces the erroneous coarse565.628m sample. Cliff foot/crest and curved OSM natural=cliff420831294 control the rock ribbon. Upper cliff heights586–593m imply74.5–81.5m above the entrance; the published123m is total valley-to-crest relief. Sixteen-metre core and32m outer triangular lower-only cuts reproduce the national relief profile. The36m-wide49m-high17m-deep cave aperture and rock jointing are photograph-scaled estimates, not a surveyed cave model. Authored cliff shoulders meet the sampled ridge; source forest outside the narrow rock footprint remains native. The384m valley correction envelope blends back to the measured production DEM over its outer96m to prevent an artificial pit edge. The authored building and entrance ownership includes a small canopy margin to prevent trees intersecting the facade.
attribution: Original procedural metric mesh; no downloaded mesh or photo textures. Map ring evidence: © OpenStreetMap contributors (ODbL), via Protomaps. Operator texts/images are referenced, not redistributed.
review_status: Final actual-engine capture reviewed on9a4cdd0214ef38fe6cd7daa0d78ed55d03ae26f7a8a14185e5d0c3be7eaf15b5. Castle facade clear of tree intersection; widened terrain transition removes harsh pit edge, authored cave/cliff visible and entrance contacts ground.
